headline: Grid Constraints Force India to Curtail 119 GW of Renewable Power in September
summary: India curtailed 118.6 GW of renewable energy capacity in September, including 96.9 GW of solar and 21.7 GW of wind power. Grid flexibility constraints, transmission bottlenecks, and limited battery storage caused the curtailments.
why: India is one of the fastest-growing markets for renewable energy capacity, but infrastructure bottlenecks can restrict generation revenues and slow clean energy targets.

impacts.name: Indian Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Transmission bottlenecks and storage deficits prevent clean energy operators from delivering produced electricity to end users.
